name: week
title: The dispatch week
subtitle: Pours booked, loads to send and what needs chasing

sections.title: Pour schedule
sections.sql: select code,pour_date,start_time,status,customer,site,mix,plant,pump,to_send_m3,loads_left,credit_hold from v_pour_schedule order by pour_date,start_time,code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind,record,due,detail from v_attention order by due,kind,record

name: quality
title: Plant quality
subtitle: Sampling against production, results due and strength margins

sections.title: Sampling in the last 90 days
sections.note: The plant rule is set per plant (test_every_m3). Confirm it against the standard and audit scheme your plant works to.
sections.sql: select plant,test_every_m3,produced_m3,samples_needed,samples_taken,samples_short from v_test_frequency order by plant

sections.title: Results due from the lab
sections.sql: select sample,mix,customer,sampled_on,due_7,mpa_7,due_28,mpa_28 from v_samples where mpa_28 is null order by due_28

sections.title: Mix performance at 28 days
sections.sql: select mix,grade_mpa,count(mpa_28) results,round(avg(mpa_28),1) mean_mpa,min(mpa_28) lowest_mpa from v_samples group by mix,grade_mpa order by mix

name: dockets
title: Docket checks
subtitle: Missing times, signatures, water added and loads not yet invoiced

sections.title: Docket record checks
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from v_compliance where rule in ('DOCKET-INCOMPLETE','DISCHARGE-TIME','WATER-ADDED') order by rule,record

sections.title: Loads not invoiced
sections.sql: select docket_no,day,order_code,customer,mix,volume_m3 from v_dockets where invoice_ref is null order by day,docket_no

sections.title: Returned concrete
sections.sql: select customer,mix,sum(returned_m3) returned_m3,sum(volume_m3) sent_m3 from v_dockets where returned_m3>0 group by customer,mix order by returned_m3 desc
